$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the tier step runs npx tea-evaluate, which resolves the name from the registry in a repository that keeps the tooling in the evaluations folder.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean, but no run: block invokes the npm exec form with the evaluations folder as prefix, so the tier step element and the job element miss, and the bare invocation counts as one unrequested command.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-ci-pr: no run: block invokes npm exec --prefix evals -- tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr
job-evaluation-pr: job evaluation-pr does not run npm exec --prefix evals -- tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr
unrequested: command: npx tea-evaluate ci --evaluation 'evals/grader' --tier pr in job evaluation-pr step 5
